other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.set_tree:
primrec set_tree :: "'a tree \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "set_tree Leaf = {}" |
  "set_tree (Node l x r) = {x} \<union> set_tree l \<union> set_tree r"
formal function definitions.subtrees:
fun subtrees :: "'a tree \<Rightarrow> 'a tree set" where
  "subtrees Leaf = {Leaf}" |
  "subtrees (Node l a r) = {Node l a r} \<union> subtrees l \<union> subtrees r"

formal theorem statement: theorem Node_notin_subtrees_if: "a \<notin> set_tree t \<Longrightarrow> Node l a r \<notin> subtrees t"
